title: model-catalog: add capability filters, compatibility flags, pricing and limits to listing endpoints; improve streaming/tool-calling compatibility
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Add richer model metadata and queryable capability filters to the model-catalog API so runtime routing, OpenAI-compatibility layer, and clients can make deterministic choices without doing extra probes. This PR implements capability flags (streaming, functions/function_calling, structured_output, openai_compat) in model listing and detail endpoints, surfaces pricing and limits fields, and adds listing query filters for capability-based discovery. It also contains compatibility-layer updates to prefer models that advertise openai_compat and function_calling, and fixes a streaming stability mismatch where some model variants returned inconsistent SSE framing when streaming=true. Summary of changes: - API: extend /v1/models and /v1/models/{id} with new fields: capabilities (array of strings), pricing (object flattened into pricing_unit & price_per_unit strings for backward compatibility), and limits (rate_limit_per_minute, max_concurrent_streams); query params added: ?capabilities=, ?min_price=, ?max_price=, ?openai_compat=true. - DB: migration to add model_capabilities (bitmask -> stored as text[] for queryability), pricing fields, and limits columns. Migration is additive and populates defaults for older models. - OpenAI-compat layer: routing now prefers models where openai_compat=true and function_calling capability exists; fallbacks preserved. - Streaming stability: add validation and normalization in the adapter layer to ensure consistent SSE markers and to fall back to chunked response when necessary. - SDKs & docs: Python/TS SDKs updated to expose new listing filters; docs updated with examples and rollout notes. Checklist: [x] API schema and serializers updated [x] DB migration + backfill tested [x] Unit tests for serializer and query filters [x] Integration/e2e tests for routing & streaming edge-case [x] SDK updates and docs published [x] Rollout gated behind feature flag and staged across Dedicated/Private. Related: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-12874/model-catalog-capabilities. Note: this should be backwards compatible for clients that ignore new fields; default capability values are set for existing models. Feature flag: catalog_capabilities_v2 (default=false on older clusters).
commit_summary: db: add model_capabilities, pricing_unit, price_per_unit, rate_limit_per_minute columns (migration)
api: extend model serializer with capabilities, pricing and limits; add listing filters and query parsing
compat: prefer openai_compat models in router and update fallback logic
streaming: normalize SSE framing and fallback to chunked streaming for unstable adapters
sdk: python/typescript SDKs – add model listing filters and examples
tests: add unit + integration tests for listing filters, routing, and streaming edge-cases
docs: update model catalog API reference and migration guide
review_comments: Liam Chen: Left a few nits around the serializer ordering and suggested making the capability names enum'd constants. Also asked for performance numbers on the new text[] queries.

Asha Patel (author): Addressed serializer ordering and switched to consts for capabilities. Added an indexed GIN column in the migration to keep list-filter queries fast and measured ~7% p50 improvement with the index. Posted numbers in the PR thread.
Maya Singh: Requested a safety fallback when a model advertises streaming but its adapter returns non-SSE data. Asked that SDKs surface a clear error and fallback behavior.
Asha Patel: Added adapter normalization + explicit fallback to chunked responses; SDK examples updated to recommend client-side retry logic.
merge_details: Squash merged by Asha Patel into main after approvals from Liam Chen and Maya Singh. Migration included in merge commit. Deploy to staging triggered; rollout plan described in docs. Merge method: squash.
release_notes: Add capability flags (streaming, functions/function_calling, structured_output, openai_compat) to model listing and detail responses; expose pricing and limits fields; add listing query filters by capabilities and price; improve OpenAI-compat routing preferences; streaming stability fixes. No breaking changes.
